model_output:
```sql
WITH hotel_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.406222, 37.797376), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
region_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    geometry
  FROM 
    regions
  WHERE 
    region_name ILIKE 'San Francisco' 
    AND border_type = 'city'
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM hotel_geom)::geometry, TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM hotel_geom)::geometry)
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_ValueCount(clipped_rast, TRUE) AS stats
  FROM 
    dem_clip
),
hotel_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(rast, 1, ST_Centroid((SELECT geom FROM hotel_geom)::geometry)) AS hotel_elev
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM hotel_geom)::geometry)
),
region_mean_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_StatsAgg(stats).mean AS mean_elev
  FROM 
    elevation_stats
)
SELECT 
  'Susie Hotel' AS hotel_name,
  (SELECT hotel_elev FROM hotel_elevation) AS hotel_elevation,
  (SELECT mean_elev FROM region_mean_elevation) AS regional_mean_elevation
WHERE 
  (SELECT hotel_elev FROM hotel_elevation) > (SELECT mean_elev FROM region_mean_elevation);
```
